headlines.title: 허장, APEC서 디지털 인프라 투자 강조 … 전략형 국부펀드 추진
headlines.summary: 국민성장펀드 통한 민간투자 촉진 방안 공유…장기 인내자본 공급 추진 중국·캐나다·뉴질랜드와 경제협력 논의…OECD "한국 경제전망 긍정적" 허장 재정경제부 2차관 (재정경제부 제공. 재판매 및 DB 금지) 2026.9.

headlines.title: 재경차관 " 전략형 국부펀드 도입 … 디지털 인프라에 장기자금 공급 "
headlines.summary: APEC 재무장관회의서 전략산업 투자 지원 계획 밝혀 글로벌·민간 자금 유치할 '앵커투자자' 역할도 추진 국민성장펀드 소개…캐나다와 국부펀드 정책 방향 공유 [서울=뉴시스] 허장 재정경제부 2차관이 지난달 22일 서울 종로구 무역보험공사에서 '2026년 제4차 조달정책심의위원회'를 주재하고 있는 모습. (사진=재정경제부 제공) 2026.09.22.

headlines.title: 20조 한국형 국부펀드 ... 내년 출범 입법 속도전
headlines.summary: ‘KIC 전략투자계정 신설’안 발의 저축·전략형 가능 ‘종합형’ 개편 내년 20조원이 넘는 한국형 국부펀드 출범을 위한 입법에 속도가 붙고 있다. 핵심은 한국투자공사(KIC)에 전략투자계정을 신설해 저축형과 전략형 기능을 모두 갖춘 종합형 국부펀드로 확대·개편하는 것이다.

headlines.title: 10월 1~20일 수출 616억 달러 … 반도체 222% 증가
headlines.summary: 작년보다 105% 늘어 역대 최대 경기 평택시 포승읍 평택항에 수출용 컨테이너가 쌓여있는 모습. 2026.10.1 ⓒ 뉴스1 이달 1∼20일 수출액이 616억 달러로 10월 기준 역대 최대치를 기록했다. 반도체 수출액이 전년 동기 대비 3배 이상으로 늘면서 전체 수출을 이끌었다.

headlines.title: 반도체 호황에도 저·고소득층 엇갈린 살림살이
headlines.summary: 韓銀 지역별 대출 현황 분석 소득 1분위 적자액 1년 새 1.3%↑ 처분소득보다 소비지출 더 늘어 5분위는 흑자액 5.3만원 증가해 전문가 “간극 메울 정부노력 필요” 최근 1년 소득 하위 20%인 1분위의 가계살림 적자 규모가 그 이전 1년과 비교해 소폭 악화된 것으로 확인됐다. 가처분소득 증가분보다 소비지출이 더 크게 늘면서다.

headlines.title: “ 중소기업 도 AI 대전환 주체 로”… 중기중앙회 정책토론회
headlines.summary: 기조연설에 박영선 재경부 위원장 중소기업중앙회는 21일 롯데호텔 제주에서 재정경제부와 함께 ‘피지컬 AI 시대, 중소기업의 혁신전략은?’을 주제로 정책토론회를 개최했다. ‘2026 중소기업 리더스포럼’의 일환으로 열린 이날 행사에는 산업계와 학계, 정부 관계자 및 중소기업 대표 등 200여명이 참석했다.

headlines.title: 한국 70조 내라더니…" 알래스카 LNG 사업비 2배 늘수도" 보고서 파장

headlines.title: " 할당관세 1천586억원 감면했지만 … 가격 인하효과 제한적 "
headlines.summary: 분석 대상 10개 품목 중 7개는 가격 인하 효과 확인 안돼 임미애 "관세 감면분이 소비자가격에 반영되는지 추적·공개해야" 할당관세 품목 점검 (인천=연합뉴스) 임순석 기자 = 9일 인천 연수구 인천세관 보세창고에서 관세청 직원들이 할당관세 품목인 수입 설탕 반출점검을 시연하고 있다. 2026.9.9 soonseok02@yna.co.

headlines.title: 코인과세 유예로 기우는 정부 ...“1100만 투자자에 영향 커”
headlines.summary: 과세 인프라·디지털법 미비 재경부 22일 종합감사 주목 野, “민주당과 간사협의 추진” 권대영(가운데) 재정경제부 제1차관이 20일 서울지방조달청에서 열린 ‘가상자산 과세 관련 현장 간담회’에서 발언하고 있다. 재정경제부 내년 1월 시행 예정인 가상화폐 과세에 대한 반발이 커지면서 정부 내 기류가 유예 쪽으로 기울어지고 있다.

headlines.title: 너도나도 “ 평수 줄여 이사 ”… 소형아파트 전세지수 역대 최고

headlines.title: 정규직 405만원 vs 비정규직 211만원 … 월급 194만원 차

headlines.title: 비정규직 역대 최고 임금 격차 194만원
headlines.summary: 전체 근로자 비중의 38.5% 60세 이상 36.7% 가장 많아 2025년보다 10만3000명 증가 정규직 월급 4% 늘 때 1% ↑ 노동시장에서 비정규직 근로자가 차지하는 비중이 역대 최고치인 38.5%를 기록했다. 정규직 대비 비정규직의 증가폭이 10배를 웃돌았지만, 비정규직의 임금은 정규직의 절반 수준에 머물렀다.

headlines.title: 정부 정책이 가른 쌀값 … 日 43% 떨어질때 韓은 4% 하락

top5_headlines.summary: 분석 대상 10개 품목 중 7개는 가격 인하 효과 확인 안돼 임미애 "관세 감면분이 소비자가격에 반영되는지 추적·공개해야" 할당관세 품목 점검 (인천=연합뉴스) 임순석 기자 = 9일 인천 연수구 인천세관 보세창고에서 관세청 직원들이 할당관세 품목인 수입 설탕 반출점검을 시연하고 있다. 2026.9.9 soonseok02@yna.co.

key_headlines.title: Small apartments surge in Jeonse market amid rental crisis
key_headlines.summary: Demand for smaller apartments (under 60 sqm) is shifting significantly, with Jeonse (long-term lease) prices for small units hitting record highs as renters downsize to manage housing costs during an intensifying rental shortage.

key_headlines.title: October exports hit record 61.6 billion dollars, semiconductor exports triple
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's October exports for the first 20 days reached 61.6 billion dollars, the highest on record for the month, driven by semiconductor exports surging 222% year-over-year.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea holds policy rate at 3.0%, sees growth significantly exceeding forecasts
key_headlines.summary: The Bank of Korea maintained its benchmark interest rate at 3.0% while projecting this year's and next year's economic growth will substantially exceed previous August forecasts, aided by robust semiconductor performance.

key_headlines.title: Income gap widens as low-income households face increased deficits
key_headlines.summary: Despite semiconductor export boom, lower-income households (bottom 20%) saw household deficits worsen by 1.3% annually as consumption spending exceeded disposable income growth, while top earners increased savings.

key_headlines.title: Quota tariff relief of 158.6 billion won shows limited consumer price reduction effects
key_headlines.summary: Analysis reveals that of 10 quota tariff items examined, 7 showed no confirmed price reduction effects, raising concerns that tariff reductions are not being passed through to consumers.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy shows a mixed picture with strong semiconductor-driven export growth contrasting sharply with household financial stress. October exports reached record highs with semiconductor shipments tripling year-over-year, signaling robust economic expansion. However, the rental market is experiencing severe disruptions with Jeonse prices for small apartments hitting record levels as budget-conscious renters downsize their living spaces. New Jeonse contracts in Seoul have plummeted 34% this year to levels not seen since 2022, while renewal contracts are becoming increasingly difficult for tenants facing higher security deposits.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea held its benchmark rate at 3.0% on October 22nd, pausing after two consecutive hikes in July and August to assess economic conditions. The central bank significantly upgraded its growth forecasts, projecting this year's and next year's economic expansion will substantially exceed the August outlook of 3.3%, primarily due to semiconductor sector strength. Inflation remains elevated at 2.9%, and the BOK acknowledged ongoing cost pressures from Middle East tensions will continue to transmit through the economy, keeping future rate hikes a possibility. Market expectations suggest additional rate increases may resume in November as inflation pressures persist despite the current pause.
sections.Financial Markets: Stock markets displayed weakness despite positive signals from the Bank of Korea's policy decision, with the KOSPI falling below the 5,700 level intraday as investors reassessed economic prospects. U.S. Treasury yields have risen to 5% levels, reflecting continued inflation concerns and reduced expectations for near-term rate cuts from the Federal Reserve, pressuring global financial conditions. South Korea's long-term government bond yields are rising amid expectations of further BOK rate increases and global fiscal pressures. The rebound in U.S. markets overnight provided some support, but Korean investors remained cautious, suggesting the rate pause may not signal an end to the tightening cycle.
sections.Industry & Technology: Battery and energy technology companies are positioning themselves for growth driven by AI infrastructure demands and electrification trends. EcoPro, celebrating its 28th anniversary, emphasized that opportunities for ternary cathode batteries will expand significantly as AI, robotics, and next-generation mobility sectors drive higher energy density requirements. The defense sector is also mobilizing, with companies like Samgi Energy Solutions showcasing defense-grade battery packs at aerospace exhibitions. Multiple companies are developing solutions to address the mounting power consumption demands of AI data centers, including heat pump technology, nuclear power expansion, and energy storage systems.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's apartment market continues its 89-week upward trend with simultaneous increases in both sales prices (0.13%) and Jeonse deposits (0.16%), creating dual pressures on non-homeowner households. The core issue is supply shortage rather than price instability, with apartment complexes in premium education districts like Gangnam's Daechi-dong commanding prices 230 million won higher than district averages for 84 sqm units. The government attributes the shift from Jeonse to monthly rentals to factors including single-person household growth and aftereffects of previous Jeonse fraud cases, prompting policy discussions on housing supply expansion.
sections.International Economy: U.S.-Canada trade tensions are intensifying beyond tariff disputes into political negotiations ahead of midterm elections, with Trump administration officials warning Canada against lobbying efforts on trade policy. SpaceX's achievement of first-quarter profitability boosted Wall Street performance, with major indices gaining on strong corporate earnings. Chinese manufacturing companies are actively relocating to Thailand to avoid U.S. tariffs, with Chinese investments in Thailand reaching 1.9 trillion won in the first half of 2026, double their investment levels in Vietnam. Samsung Biologics is benefiting from reduced U.S. tariff policy uncertainty with recovering customer inquiries that could translate into significant orders next year.
sections.AI & Economy: Power infrastructure represents the biggest constraint on AI industry growth, with Goldman Sachs warning that global data center electricity demand will surge 170% between 2025-2030, with over 60% concentrated in the U.S. IBM's CEO reports that major corporations are increasingly scrutinizing actual return on investment from AI spending, with some companies concerned about uncontrolled cost growth without proportional revenue gains. Korean AI infrastructure companies like AnyBridge are attracting venture investment with technology to reduce AI inference costs by 40-70%, while AdForous is raising 6 billion won in additional funding to integrate AI capabilities into existing platforms for enhanced profitability.
sections.Others: The government is establishing implementation strategies for seven advanced technology sectors including small modular reactors (SMRs), nuclear fusion, quantum computing, and others as future growth engines, with emphasis on demonstration projects and commercialization beyond basic R&D. Solidum's planned U.S. Nasdaq listing has been identified as duplicate listing, with financial authorities clarifying that SK Hynix must fulfill shareholder duties regarding the subsidiary's international public offering. The U.S. State Department has denied involvement in restricting Starlink access for Ukraine, attributing service changes to SpaceX's independent decisions, while emphasizing continued U.S. support for Ukrainian defense capabilities.
